description_expanded: SummaryEscape to our spacious 4-bedroom, 4.5-bathroom vacation rental in between Alys Beach and Seacrest. This two-story stilt home offers modern amenities like central A/C, high-speed WiFi, and private ensuite bathrooms for each bedroom. Relax on the private balconies, enjoy the outdoor dining area, or take advantage of the fully equipped kitchen. Perfect for families or groups of up to 13, this serene coastal retreat is just minutes from the beach.SpaceWelcome to BEACH RETREAT -a tranquil sanctuary where simple pleasures and natural beauty come together. Located just steps from the shore, this charming beach house offers exclusive private beach access, making it easy to lose yourself in the rhythm of the waves and find peace by the sea. Start your mornings with a quiet coffee on the spacious main-level porch, or sip cocktails in the fresh coastal air as the day winds down. For a breathtaking view, head up to the private balcony off the primary bedroom to take in the sparkling Gulf and soak in a serene sunset. Nestled less than a mile from Alys Beach, Beach Retreat invites you to slow down and explore by foot. Stroll to charming local cafes and boutique shops, discover hidden corners, or simply wander in search of nature’s beauty along this scenic stretch of 30A. With all the comforts of home, Beach Retreat is designed for peaceful moments with family and friends. Here, you can reconnect with loved ones and immerse yourself in the serenity of a beach escape that’s as effortless as it is unforgettable. HELPFUL NEIGHBORHOOD INFORMATION - PRIVATE beach access just a 1-2 minute walk! No crowds! - Direct access to the Timpoochee Trail which provides 18 miles to run/walk/bike to the seaside communities along 30A. - Easy access to Alys/Rosemary Beach to the East. SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (SLEEPS 12) - King Bedroom: 1st floor- King bed with ensuite bathroom - Twin Bedroom: 1st floor- 2 Twin beds and daybed with ensuite bathroom - King Bedroom: 2nd floor - King bed with ensuite bathroom and private balcony with view - Bunk Room: 2nd floor - 2 Bunk sets (twin over full) with ensuite bathroom FEATURES - Private neighborhood beach access steps from this home - Full kitchen, walk in pantry, stainless steel appliances - Gas Grill - Outdoor shower - Beach Chairs, towels, toys, wagon - 4 Bedrooms with ensuite bathrooms - Smart TVs in each bedroom with Roku - Full-sized washer and dryer - Gulf View from balcony - Large comfortable living area - Large covered porch - Direct access to Timpoochee Trail, minutes to Alys beach - Discount provided for pontoon rentals and yacht charters, bike rentals and golf cart rentalsNeighborhoodThis small street is private and thus has access to a private beach. No crowds - no matter what time of year!House Rules1. Smoking is NOT allowed inside the Rental Property. A $500 smoking fee will be charged to guests if smoking inside Rental Property occurs or evidence is found of smoking inside. 2. People other than included in the Guest Count may not stay in the property. Any other person on Rental Property is the sole responsibility of Guest. 3. Quiet Hours are 10pm – 8am. Excessive noise inside these hours are not permitted and will result in eviction and cancellation with no refund. 4. Rental Property is privately owned; Owner/Property Manager is not responsible for any accidents, injuries or illness that occurs while on the Rental Property or its facilities. The Owner/Property Manager is not responsible for the loss of personal belongings or valuables of the Guest and Rental Party. By accepting this reservation, it is agreed that Guests and Rental Party are expressly assuming the risk of any harm arising from their use of the Rental Property or others whom they invite to use the Rental Property. 5. Guest agrees to keep the property and all furnishings in good order and only use appliances for their intended uses. 6. Pets are not allowed. If violated, a $500 fee will be charged and Guest will be evicted. 7. Housekeeping: There is no daily housekeeping service. While linens and bath towels are included in the unit, daily maid service is not included in the rental rate. We do not permit towels or linens to be taken from the property unless used for amenities outside the property such as shared hot tub and pool areas. Please return the linens in the Property after use. 8. Water and Septic: The septic system is very effective; however, it will clog up if improper material is flushed. DO NOT FLUSH anything other than toilet paper. No feminine products should be flushed at any time. If it is found that feminine products have been flushed and clog the septic system, you will be charged for any damages incurred by Property Manager or Owner. 9. Renter(s) are responsible for themselves, their family and guests at all times. Children should be supervised at all times. 10. If Rental Party exceeds the maximum occupancy Guest will be asked to leave the Rental Property with no refunds. Infants under 2 years are not counted. 11. At least one parent or adult must be present at all times when children under the age of 16 are in the Rental Property or using any of outdoor facilities such as Hot Tub. 12. Owner/Property Manager is not responsible for money, jewelry, or other valuables lost, stolen, or left behind in the Rental Property, but will use their best effort to remedy the situation. 13. No rowdy behavior is permitted. Guests must behave at all times, in a reasonable and proper manner and act in a way as to protect the Rental Property, its contents and furnishings against damage. Failure to do so could result in eviction. 14. No subletting of the Rental Property or assigning of this agreement is permitted. 15. Please note that we charge per guest after a set number. Please provide the entire group count in your reservation request. If an update to the group count is needed after confirming the reservation, the reservation cost may increase. 16. Guest must obtain approval prior to checking in early or check out late. If Guest enter the Rental Property before agreed upon Check In Time or leave the Rental Property after agreed upon Check Out Time, Guest will be charged $50/half hour. 17. Guest is responsible to learn and understand any mandates, restrictions or public health orders relating to COVID-19 before confirming a reservation. 18. Guest agrees that they are 25 years of age or older. 19. If applicable, Guest may be responsible for loss of any parking passes/permits in amounts up to $400 per pass/permit. 20. Emotional Support Animals (ESA) are not allowed unless explicitly approved by Owner/Manager. If violated, a $500 fee will be charged to the Guest and Guest will be evicted. 21. Bicycles must yield to pedestrians when riding on sidewalks. Use designated crosswalks and follow all traffic laws. 22. Helmets are required for riders under 16. Nighttime riding requires a front light and rear reflectors for visibility. 23. Only licensed and insured drivers may operate golf carts and low-speed vehicles (LSVs). 24. Golf carts and LSVs must follow Florida motor vehicle laws and may only be driven on roads with speed limits of 35 mph or less. 25. Golf carts and LSVs may not be driven on sidewalks or bike paths. Working headlights and taillights are required for nighttime use. 26. Bicycles must be locked when parked and marked with identification for return. Guests are responsible for any loss, theft, or damage during the rental. 27. Golf cart and LSV drivers must ensure all passengers wear seatbelts and do not exceed passenger limits. 28. Reckless driving or unauthorized modifications to golf carts and LSVs is prohibited. Park responsibly and return vehicles clean and fully charged or refueled. 29. LSVs and bicycles are not allowed within the Rosemary Beach Community. 30. Guests are responsible for any fines, tickets, or damages incurred during use. Bicycles and golf carts/LSVs must be returned in the same condition as provided. 31. Guests acknowledge the inherent risks of using bicycles and operating golf carts/LSVs. 32. Guests agree to indemnify and hold harmless LocalVR, its owners, and employees from any claims or damages arising from use. 33. LocalVR and the property owner are not liable for injuries or damages incurred, except in cases of gross negligence or willful misconduct. Read More
